info.title: SaleSync Online API
info.description: Cookie-based same-site API. Mutations require an approved Origin and JSON; authenticated non-auth mutations require X-CSRF-Token. Staff are provisioned through the local CLI. Approved customer-owned stores gain seller capabilities without administrative roles. Development payments are local simulations only; no PayMongo or real charges.

post.summary: Management: idempotent full/partial local-test refund
post.description: No real money moves. Selected quantities use original net paid amounts with cumulative integer-cent rounding. Dispatched items require a received return; refund that case’s quantities together. Shipping can be refunded only after all item quantities are included/refunded; items:[] plus refundShipping:true supports a later shipping-only refund. Partial requests require Idempotency-Key. Exact replays return the original outcome without another restock. Stale revisions and over-refunds are rejected.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required for partial refunds; reuse the same key and request body for a retry.
